name: arrstatus
author: Michal Gritzbach
description: qBittorrent / SABnzbd / *arr download activity in the Omarchy bar, with a per-service panel

barWidget.description: Total download speed and active count in the bar; a panel with one section per service, progress meters, status and ETA. Hides itself when everything is idle.

schema.label: Script path or shell command
schema.description: Overrides the bundled waybar/arrstatus.py. Called with --json and must print the structured report.
